english:
Killing a <void Weaken />ed enemy with a <void Void /> Weapon applies <void Volatile /> to enemies within 6 meters.

<link Elite Tier or higher [#CombatantClassifications] /> Combatants and Guardians increase the radius to 15 meters.

Has a 3 second cooldown between triggers.

source.text:
On Weakened Enemy Kill with a Void Weapon:

Inflicts Volatile to enemies within 6 meters.
Elite+ Combatants and Guardians increase the radius to 15 meters.

Incurs a 3 second cooldown upon triggering.
